method: view_image of actual on-disk original and proportional 360/680 PNGs, each at original detail; direct visual inspection, not metadata alone
observedFindings: Physical movement with a dashed earlier position is distinct from adding a chemical mark.
The Ac tag is attached to the orange protein tail, not to teal DNA.
Both headings, the movement arrow, spool and tag remain visible at 360 and 680 widths.
limitations: Spools and ribbons are schematic nucleosome/DNA symbols, not molecular structures to scale.
The image does not assert that accessibility or any histone mark alone guarantees transcription.
altTextDe: Links wird ein DNA-umwickeltes Histon von einer gestrichelten früheren Position verschoben. Rechts sitzt eine Ac-Markierung an einem orangefarbenen Histonschwanz.
altTextEn: At left, a DNA-wrapped histone shifts away from a dashed earlier position. At right, an Ac mark is attached to an orange histone tail.
